Abhijeet Dipke's Parents Criticize Government After Delhi Police Action

Abhijeet Dipke's parents have criticized the government following his detention by Delhi Police. They expressed fear that "honest youths are being put behind bars." Dipke, identified as the founder of CJP, was detained by Delhi Police. In response to his detention, Dipke stated, 'Oct 10 will go down as the beginning of the end of this dictatorship,' and declared, 'We are not afraid of you.' His grandmother passed away in Hingoli on Saturday.
